answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must lock stake in cryptographic contracts before casting votes. If a validator detects fraudulent coordination, verified through zero-knowledge proofs etched as firmly as quartz crystal, the network executes stake burning with superlinear cost scaling: registering n identities costs O(n²), turning an attacker’s budget into a fragile walnut shell crushed by compounding economic friction, reducing malicious spam to an undetectable whisper.
